headline: China and EU Address Agricultural Trade and Market Access in Sectoral Talks
summary: China and the US held the first meeting of a working group on agriculture under the bilateral trade council in Beijing on Monday and Tuesday, the Chinese commerce ministry said.
why: Agricultural trade between China and the US, including soybeans and other farm goods, is a significant part of the bilateral trade relationship.
original_headline: China y EU abordan comercio agrícola y acceso a los mercados en conversaciones sectoriales
